item.description: Donald Trump has appointed New York Representative Elise Stefanik as his incoming Ambassador to the UN. item.title: Why Ebola is No Longer a Great Global Threat - UN Dispatch
item.description: Listeners will no doubt remember the devastating Ebola outbreak of 2014–2016. More than 28,600 people were infected, and 11,325 people died across several countries in West Africa. One of the hardest-hit places was Sierra Leone, where nearly 4,000 people lost their lives. item.description: The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) released its annual assessment of global humanitarian needs today. It’s a grim document. item.title: UN Syria Envoy Geir Pedersen is Suddenly the Key Diplomat Managing the International Response to Syria’s Political Transition. - UN Dispatch
item.description: When the Syrian civil war erupted in 2011, it had all the makings of a monumental catastrophe. item.title: How the UN Can Help Syria - UN Dispatch
item.description: It’s a new day in Damascus. But what about New York? For the last 14 years, the United Nations’ role in Syria has been relegated to the circumscribed (but vital) task of supporting the humanitarian needs of millions of Syrians.
